Rules
Vanilla 1:1Same as Konami's 2008 game
EnhancedWith the optional improvements
Open: anyone signs up from the game's login screen. Otherwise only the accounts you create in Manage can log in.
Level 1 players can only enter beginner rooms (like the original game). Pick 2+ so new players can join everyone.
Each duel costs 1 point (a match needs 3 to start), like the original. More points = more duels before they run out.
Free duels (no Duelpass cost) Not in the original game. Duels don't spend points, and every new character gets the starting points.

Join with code

    
Paste the code the host gave you. It's the only way into hidden servers, and it skips any password.

      
      

    

  

  
  

    
Join by address

    
Connect straight to the host, without the public network. The host shares their address and opens that port on their router.
